description: Normalized sportsbook quote contract shared by ml/odds.py (feed), js/engine/odds.js (validation/matching) and the CV / SGP engines.

single.book: string — sportsbook identity, never merged across books
single.market: player_sog | player_points | player_goals | player_assists | player_blocks | player_hits | player_ppp | goalie_saves
single.line: number — x.5 lines settle with no push; integer lines may push

sgp.legs: array of exactly 3, 5 or 8 {market, player_id, line, side}; no duplicates
sgp.american: integer — the sportsbook's ACTUAL combined SGP price (never a product of single prices)

rejection_rules: player not in that game's projected lineup
settlement: Player props settle on NHL-recorded stats including overtime, excluding shootout. A player who does not dress voids (books reprice the SGP — reprice rules are book-specific and are NOT modelled; such parlays are marked unsupported). Goalie legs are evaluated conditional on starting.
